title: Audiologist, Radiographer, Health Inspector and Other Posts
age_limit: 45 Years & Below (as applicable per post details)
summary: District Health Society, Nilgiris invites applications for temporary contract appointments across various posts including Audiologist, Radiographer, Health Inspector, and Support Staff totaling 33 vacancies. Eligible candidates must submit their filled applications by 07.12.2026 through post or in person to the District Health Officer, Udhagamandalam.
eligibility_bullets: Educational qualifications vary by post ranging from 8th Pass, High School/Diploma, +2 Science, to Bachelor's/Master's Degrees in relevant fields (Audiology, Radiography, Nursing, Social Work, Special Education, etc.).
Age limits apply with specific posts requiring candidates to be 35 or 45 years and below.
Selected candidates must execute an undertaking/agreement for 11 months.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application format from the official website nilgiris.nic.in.
Fill out the application form completely and attach self-attested copies of educational, community, and experience certificates along with a passport-size photograph.
Submit the completed application in person or via Speed Post to the District Health Officer, No.38 Jail Hill Road, Near CT Scan, Udhagamandalam 643001 on or before 07.12.2026 by 5:00 PM.
